description: This file contains configuration settings and utility functions for the MCP (Multi-Component Platform) service within the Superset project, including caching, storage, authentication, and request parsing configurations.

methods.name: create_default_mcp_auth_factory
methods.description: Creates an MCP authentication provider based on app configuration, supporting JWT verification with HS256 or RS256 algorithms.

methods.name: default_user_resolver
methods.description: Extracts username or user identifier from a JWT access token.

methods.name: generate_secret_key
methods.description: Generates a secure random secret key using secrets.token_urlsafe.

methods.name: get_mcp_config
methods.description: Returns the complete MCP configuration dictionary, merging defaults with optional app configuration.

methods.name: get_mcp_config_with_overrides
methods.description: Returns MCP configuration allowing custom keys beyond predefined defaults.

methods.name: get_mcp_factory_config
methods.description: Returns the FastMCP factory configuration dictionary.
